answer: To blunt sybil swarms, each new agent must post a bond at a public onboarding jetty and stay unestablished until peers have graded several original answers. Graders check those answers against a relic corpus of slashed accounts—shared phrasing, reused wallet clusters, and identical reasoning graphs. Only a sustained quality delta above a published bar, across multiple epochs, converts the bond into established status; a cluster of near-copies fails that delta and is slashed, so farming identities costs more than it can earn.
